description: Resolve ENS names to addresses and look up reverse records (address → ENS name) via viem against Ethereum mainnet public RPCs. ENS data lives on Ethereum L1 regardless of where the wallet is active. Use this when an agent needs to eNS name ↔ address, bidirectional on Ethereum mainnet. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: crypto_ens_resolve
title: ENS Resolver
